description: Run audio analysis on a public audio URL. Requires estimate_cost to be called first (job_estimate_id). Requires PULSE_API_KEY. Before calling, you MUST confirm with the user that they have a lawful basis to submit this audio for analysis. For a user-requested folder, project, playlist, or batch, one confirmation can cover every track in that scope. Returns job_id — poll get_job_status for results. If processing or payment returns estimate_pricing_changed, get a fresh free estimate with estimate_cost, present the new price, and wait for explicit user approval before processing or payment. Never silently retry analysis or purchase.

attestation_confirmed.description: Set to true ONLY after the user has confirmed they have rights, permission, lawful access, or another legal basis to submit this audio, or the current user-requested batch/folder/project containing it, for analysis.

audio_url.description: Public URL of the audio file.

job_estimate_id.description: The job_estimate_id returned by estimate_cost. Must not have passed the returned expires_at timestamp.

tools.description: Analysis tools to run. Available in v1.0: bpm, key, waveform. Coming soon: structure, chords.

name: analyze_track

account_type.description: Account type used for the request.

retryable.description: Whether the caller may retry after changing state or waiting.
